metadata.title: Container Supply Chain

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring the integrity, provenance, and trustworthiness of container images and artifacts used in execution environments.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Container build pipelines, image registries, artifact repositories, and distribution mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for establishing trust in container artifacts from build through distribution and deployment.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Supply-chain trust builds on baseline container platform trust assumptions.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Initial access through malicious or compromised container images.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Persistence achieved through trojanized or backdoored container artifacts.

props.name: attack-tactic
props.remarks: Defense evasion by embedding malicious logic within expected container images.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Compromise of trusted software supply chain affecting container images or build systems.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Compromise of software dependencies embedded within container images.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Software provenance verification to ensure authenticity and integrity of container artifacts.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Artifact integrity validation to detect unauthorized modification of container images.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Restriction of execution to approved and verified software artifacts.

metadata.remarks: Container Supply Chain defines the trust properties required to ensure that container images and artifacts are authentic, untampered, and appropriate for deployment. This pattern addresses risks introduced prior to runtime, including malicious images, compromised build pipelines, and untrusted registries.

components.title: Image Provenance and Authenticity
components.description: Ensures container images have verifiable origin and authorship.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Container images are traceable to trusted sources and verified prior to use.

components.title: Registry and Distribution Trust
components.description: Addresses trust in container registries and artifact distribution channels.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Container registries and distribution mechanisms prevent unauthorized modification or injection of artifacts.

components.title: Artifact Integrity
components.description: Ensures container artifacts have not been altered between build and deployment.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integrity mechanisms detect or prevent unauthorized changes to container images.
